title: The Voice Inside the Note
caption: What is the harmonic series? Every note has other notes inside it. THE OBSERVER WORLD — Chapter II, Episode 8. The Keeper is out of chords: the dark learned all seven. So he holds one low sound and listens above it — and the note turns out to contain other notes. Twice the speed, an octave. Three times, a fifth. Four, five. A major chord. He never built it. He found it. It was always in there. Then the dark copies the note, takes the pitch, and misses everything standing on top of it. It can copy what you play. It cannot copy what you are made of. And this is the episode where he hears the Observer for the first time — because a voice is not a note, and the dark only ever listened for notes. the more you know, the more you observe.  #musictheory #harmonicseries #overtones #animation #theobserverworld
